about: Rules for the Bitcoin tax calculator (/bitcoin-tax-calculator.html), one sale by a private person. Every number here comes from seo-build/data/tax-sources.json (official source + quote per country) or from the source named in the country's 'src' field; build_tax_calculator.py checks the rates against tax-sources.json and stops if they differ. Change a rule here and in tax-sources.json together, then rebuild. Kinds: flat = one rate on the gain; bands = progressive rates on the whole tax base (other income + gain, the tax is the difference the gain adds); de = German income tax formula (§ 32a EStG 2026); none = private gains not taxed; box3 = wealth tax, a sale is not taxed. holdYears = years after which a sale is tax-free. reviewed = the rule was in the signed tax review of 4/5 Nov 2026.

See the note in tax-calc.js compute().
